value.rationale: Minimal nonplanar complete bipartite graph is a canonical nonplanar graph braid test object; three particles are the first case beyond familiar two-particle configuration calculations. The eight-dimensional degree-two W-module and rational acyclicity of its full-symmetry quotient are natural structural invariants not fixed by first-homology torsion or numerical Betti ranks. The result is a complete rather than arbitrarily sliced classification.
